REPLACE ONLY the large upper 'Top' panel with a STRICT TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP PLAN, camera exactly perpendicular to deck looking vertically down at 90 degrees. Bow points RIGHT, stern LEFT, matching the lower side view. In this upper panel absolutely NO cabin front wall, NO cabin side wall, NO outer hull side faces, NO rail vertical faces; only cabin ROOF and upper surfaces can be seen. No camera tilt or perspective. Navy hull outline, warm wood deck, ivory rail top and orange cabin roof edge. Draw a precise rectangular grid TEN equal columns fore-aft left-to-right and FIVE equal rows across-beam top-to-bottom. Label it 'Deck 10 m x 5 m'. Cabin roof occupies THREE rightmost grid columns in length and TWO grid rows in width, slightly toward bottom/starboard, leaving two rows above and one below cabin. This is exactly 2 m across x 3 m fore-aft; tapered bow lies beyond grid to right. Change upper caption to 'TOP / bow right / true orthographic'. Preserve lower views, art style, background and image quality. Do not redraw top as a high-angle beauty render. This correction is needed to make the sheet useful for Blender orthographic modelling.

Edit target is supplied OUTBOARD SKIFF sheet. Keep its existing exact navy/orange/ivory colour family, all hull detailing, steering console, aft outboard, lower side elevation, lower 3/4 view and title. Replace ONLY its large top-view panel and nearby dimension annotations with a STRICT TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP PLAN of the same boat, camera exactly vertical down perpendicular to the deck, no tilt. Rotate this top plan to landscape so bow is RIGHT and stern LEFT, matching lower starboard side. No visible external hull side wall, no console front or side wall, no motor vertical leg or propeller underneath; only uppermost surfaces visible. The steering console is seen only as a small ivory/orange rectangular TOP with steering rim in plan, not a front-facing wheel. Show exactly FIVE equal 1 m grid columns along length, THREE equal rows across width, rectangle fits entirely inside hull, one forward central grid cell contains the console. Outboard is outside stern at left, pointed bow beyond grid at right. Clear labels 'TOP / bow right / true orthographic', 'Deck 5 x 3 tiles', hull '6.5 m' length and '3.5 m' beam. No extra objects. Preserve friendly softly shaded clean low-poly style, neutral cream background, lower panels unchanged. This is a perpendicular plan, NOT another beauty shot.
